round: # UNDERSTAND. One dialogue per unit with the unit's new language. The first page explains the pattern in Dari (intro_fa).
# Two questions per dialogue; the right choice is not always first. Two voices: f = woman or girl

intro_fa: مادر از عمر می‌پرسد که چه حال دارد. How do you feel یعنی «چه حال داری». جواب با I feel یا I am شروع می‌شود: I feel sick، I am tired. خوب گوش کن.
say_en: f: Good morning, Omar. How do you feel? // m: I feel sick, mother.
show_en: Good morning, Omar. How do you feel? I feel sick, mother.

say_en: f: Are you hot? // m: No, I am cold. And I am tired.
show_en: Are you hot? No, I am cold. And I am tired.

say_en: How does Omar feel?
show_en: How does Omar feel?
wrong_say_fa: نه. عمر گفت I feel sick: او خود را مریض احساس می‌کند.

say_en: f: Are you hungry? // m: No, I am not hungry. I am thirsty.
show_en: Are you hungry? No, I am not hungry. I am thirsty.

say_en: What does Omar want?
show_en: What does Omar want?
wrong_say_fa: نه. عمر گرسنه نیست، تشنه است. کسی که تشنه است آب می‌خواهد.

say_en: f: Here is some water. Stay in bed today. // m: Thank you, mother.
show_en: Here is some water. Stay in bed today. Thank you, mother.

intro_fa: جواد در کلینیک است. نرس می‌پرسد What hurts یعنی «کجایت درد می‌کند». جواب: My knee hurts، زانویم درد می‌کند. گوش کن که کجای جواد درد می‌کند.
say_en: f: Hello, Jawad. What hurts? // m: My knee hurts.
show_en: Hello, Jawad. What hurts? My knee hurts.

say_en: What hurts Jawad?
show_en: What hurts Jawad?
wrong_say_fa: نه. جواد گفت My knee hurts: زانویش درد می‌کند.

say_en: f: Does your back hurt? // m: No, it doesn't. My back is fine.
show_en: Does your back hurt? No, it doesn't. My back is fine.

say_en: f: And your shoulder? // m: Yes. My shoulder hurts, too.
show_en: And your shoulder? Yes. My shoulder hurts, too.

say_en: What hurts, too?
show_en: What hurts, too?
wrong_say_fa: نه. کمر جواد جور است. شانه‌اش هم درد می‌کند: My shoulder hurts, too.

say_en: f: Sit here, please. I look at your knee. // m: Thank you.
show_en: Sit here, please. I look at your knee. Thank you.

intro_fa: کریم جور نیست. مادر می‌پرسد What is the matter یعنی «چه شده است». برای مریضی می‌گوییم I have: I have a toothache. برای کس دیگر: He has، She has.
say_en: f: Karim, what is the matter? // m: I have a toothache.
show_en: Karim, what is the matter? I have a toothache.

say_en: What does Karim have?
show_en: What does Karim have?
wrong_say_fa: نه. کریم گفت I have a toothache: دندانش درد می‌کند.

say_en: f: Do you have a fever? // m: No, I don't have a fever.
show_en: Do you have a fever? No, I don't have a fever.

say_en: f: Your sister has a cough and a cold. // m: Yes. She is in bed.
show_en: Your sister has a cough and a cold. Yes. She is in bed.

say_en: What does his sister have?
show_en: What does his sister have?
wrong_say_fa: نه. خواهر کریم سرفه و ریزش دارد: She has a cough and a cold.

say_en: f: We go to the clinic today. // m: All right, mother.
show_en: We go to the clinic today. All right, mother.

intro_fa: پدر با طفل مریض به کلینیک آمده است. در کلینیک داکتر و نرس کار می‌کنند. گوش کن که کی کجا است و کی چه می‌کند.
say_en: m: Good morning. My child is sick. // f: Good morning. Come in, please.
show_en: Good morning. My child is sick. Good morning. Come in, please.

say_en: m: Where is the doctor? // f: The doctor is in the room. I am the nurse.
show_en: Where is the doctor? The doctor is in the room. I am the nurse.

say_en: Who is she?
show_en: Who is she?
wrong_say_fa: نه. او گفت I am the nurse: او نرس است. داکتر در اطاق است.

say_en: f: Please wait here. The doctor helps a boy now. // m: Thank you. We wait.
show_en: Please wait here. The doctor helps a boy now. Thank you. We wait.

say_en: f: I take the thermometer. Does the child have a fever? // m: Yes, he is hot.
show_en: I take the thermometer. Does the child have a fever? Yes, he is hot.

say_en: What does the nurse take?
show_en: What does the nurse take?
wrong_say_fa: نه. نرس ترمامیتر را می‌گیرد تا ببیند که طفل تب دارد یا نه.

intro_fa: داکتر به حمید می‌گوید که چه کند. این جمله‌ها فرمان است: Open، Sit، Lie down. با Don't می‌گوییم که کاری را نکن: Don't move، شور نخور.
say_en: f: Hello, Hamid. Sit down here. // m: Yes, doctor.
show_en: Hello, Hamid. Sit down here. Yes, doctor.

say_en: f: Open your mouth. Say ah. // m: Ah!
show_en: Open your mouth. Say ah. Ah!

say_en: What does Hamid open?
show_en: What does Hamid open?
wrong_say_fa: نه. داکتر گفت Open your mouth: دهانت را باز کن.

say_en: f: Good. Now lie down. Breathe in. Breathe out.
show_en: Good. Now lie down. Breathe in. Breathe out.

say_en: f: Show me your arm. Don't move. // m: All right.
show_en: Show me your arm. Don't move. All right.

say_en: What does the doctor want to see?
show_en: What does the doctor want to see?
wrong_say_fa: نه. داکتر گفت Show me your arm: بازویت را به من نشان بده.

say_en: f: Very good. Come back tomorrow. // m: Thank you, doctor. Goodbye.
show_en: Very good. Come back tomorrow. Thank you, doctor. Goodbye.

intro_fa: must یعنی «باید»: کاری که حتماً لازم است. must not یعنی «نباید»: کاری که اجازه نیست. مادر به نوید می‌گوید که چه باید بکند و چه نباید بکند.
say_en: f: Navid, your hands are dirty. You must wash your hands. // m: Must I use soap?
show_en: Navid, your hands are dirty. You must wash your hands. Must I use soap?

say_en: f: Yes, you must. Soap and clean water.
show_en: Yes, you must. Soap and clean water.

say_en: What must Navid do?
show_en: What must Navid do?
wrong_say_fa: نه. دست‌های نوید چتل است. مادر گفت You must wash your hands.

say_en: m: I am thirsty. Look, water! // f: Stop! You must not drink dirty water.
show_en: I am thirsty. Look, water! Stop! You must not drink dirty water.

say_en: Which water must he drink?
show_en: Which water must he drink?
wrong_say_fa: نه. این آب چتل است. او باید آب پاک بنوشد: clean water.

say_en: f: Drink this. It is clean water. // m: Thank you, mother.
show_en: Drink this. It is clean water. Thank you, mother.

intro_fa: should یعنی «بهتر است که»: یک مشورهٔ دوستانه، نه فرمان. should not یعنی «بهتر است که نه». لیلا به برادرش مشوره می‌دهد.
say_en: m: I am very tired today. // f: You should sleep early.
show_en: I am very tired today. You should sleep early.

say_en: m: And I have a cough. // f: You should drink water. You should rest.
show_en: And I have a cough. You should drink water. You should rest.

say_en: What should he do?
show_en: What should he do?
wrong_say_fa: نه. او مانده است و سرفه دارد. لیلا گفت You should rest: بهتر است که استراحت کنی.

say_en: m: Should I go to school? // f: No. You should not go to school today.
show_en: Should I go to school? No. You should not go to school today.

say_en: Should he go to school today?
show_en: Should he go to school today?
wrong_say_fa: نه. لیلا گفت You should not go to school today: بهتر است که امروز به مکتب نرود.

say_en: f: You should go to the clinic with mother. // m: You are right. Thank you, Laila.
show_en: You should go to the clinic with mother. You are right. Thank you, Laila.

intro_fa: علی افگار شده است و خواهرش سارا کمک می‌خواهد. گوش کن که چطور کمک می‌خواهیم: Help! و Can you help me, please? و چطور می‌گوییم که احتیاط کن: Be careful!
say_en: f: Help! Help! My brother is hurt.
show_en: Help! Help! My brother is hurt.

say_en: m: What is the matter? // f: He is on the ground. His leg hurts.
show_en: What is the matter? He is on the ground. His leg hurts.

say_en: Where is Ali hurt?
show_en: Where is Ali hurt?
wrong_say_fa: نه. سارا گفت His leg hurts: پای علی درد می‌کند.

say_en: m: Don't move him. Stay with him. // f: Can you help me, please?
show_en: Don't move him. Stay with him. Can you help me, please?

say_en: m: Yes. I tell your father. Be careful!
show_en: Yes. I tell your father. Be careful!

say_en: Who does the man tell?
show_en: Who does the man tell?
wrong_say_fa: نه. مرد گفت I tell your father: او به پدر سارا خبر می‌دهد.

say_en: f: Ali, are you all right? Father comes. // m: Yes. Thank you, Sara.
show_en: Ali, are you all right? Father comes. Yes. Thank you, Sara.

intro_fa: رویا راه را نمی‌داند و از یک مرد می‌پرسد. near یعنی نزدیک، far یعنی دور، behind یعنی پشت، between یعنی بین دو چیز.
say_en: f: Excuse me, where is the clinic? // m: The clinic is near the school.
show_en: Excuse me, where is the clinic? The clinic is near the school.

say_en: f: Is it far? // m: No, it is not far. It is near.
show_en: Is it far? No, it is not far. It is near.

say_en: The clinic is near the ...
show_en: The clinic is near the ...
wrong_say_fa: نه. مرد گفت The clinic is near the school: کلینیک نزدیک مکتب است.

say_en: f: And where is the bakery? // m: It is between the shop and the school.
show_en: And where is the bakery? It is between the shop and the school.

say_en: m: The well is behind the bakery. // f: Thank you very much!
show_en: The well is behind the bakery. Thank you very much!

say_en: What is behind the bakery?
show_en: What is behind the bakery?
wrong_say_fa: نه. مرد گفت The well is behind the bakery: چاه پشت نانوایی است.

intro_fa: مینا می‌خواهد به کلینیک برود و راه را می‌پرسد: How do I get to the clinic? جواب‌ها: Go straight مستقیم برو. Turn left به دست چپ دور بخور. Turn right به دست راست.
say_en: f: Excuse me, how do I get to the clinic? // m: Go straight.
show_en: Excuse me, how do I get to the clinic? Go straight.

say_en: m: Then turn left at the school.
show_en: Then turn left at the school.

say_en: Which way at the school?
show_en: Which way at the school?
wrong_say_fa: نه. مرد گفت Turn left at the school: پیش مکتب به دست چپ دور بخور.

say_en: m: Cross the bridge. The clinic is on the right.
show_en: Cross the bridge. The clinic is on the right.

say_en: What does Mina cross?
show_en: What does Mina cross?
wrong_say_fa: نه. مرد گفت Cross the bridge: از پل تیر شو.

say_en: f: Is it far? // m: No. Walk ten minutes. // f: Thank you for your help.
show_en: Is it far? No. Walk ten minutes. Thank you for your help.

intro_fa: یوسف و خواهرش از کلکین بیرون را می‌بینند و از هوا گپ می‌زنند. برای هوا می‌گوییم It is: It is sunny، It is raining، It is windy.
say_en: m: Look out of the window. What is the weather like? // f: It is cloudy.
show_en: Look out of the window. What is the weather like? It is cloudy.

say_en: f: Oh! Now it is raining. // m: Is it cold?
show_en: Oh! Now it is raining. Is it cold?

say_en: f: Yes, it is cold and windy.
show_en: Yes, it is cold and windy.

say_en: What is the weather like now?
show_en: What is the weather like now?
wrong_say_fa: نه. خواهرش گفت Now it is raining: حالا باران می‌بارد.

say_en: m: I must go to the bazaar. // f: You should take the umbrella.
show_en: I must go to the bazaar. You should take the umbrella.

say_en: What should he take?
show_en: What should he take?
wrong_say_fa: نه. باران می‌بارد. خواهرش گفت You should take the umbrella: بهتر است که چتری را بگیری.

intro_fa: شیرین با پدرکلان از چهار فصل سال گپ می‌زند. با in می‌گوییم که در کدام فصل: in winter در زمستان، in summer در تابستان.
say_en: f: Grandfather, I don't like winter. It is cold. // m: Yes. In winter it snows.
show_en: Grandfather, I don't like winter. It is cold. Yes. In winter it snows.

say_en: m: But after winter comes spring. In spring it rains and it is warm.
show_en: But after winter comes spring. In spring it rains and it is warm.

say_en: When does it snow?
show_en: When does it snow?
wrong_say_fa: نه. پدرکلان گفت In winter it snows: در زمستان برف می‌بارد.

say_en: f: I like summer. It is hot and dry. We eat watermelon!
show_en: I like summer. It is hot and dry. We eat watermelon!

say_en: What does Shirin eat in summer?
show_en: What does Shirin eat in summer?
wrong_say_fa: نه. شیرین گفت We eat watermelon: در تابستان تربوز می‌خوریم.

say_en: m: And I like autumn. It is cool, and the trees are yellow.
show_en: And I like autumn. It is cool, and the trees are yellow.

intro_fa: was و were گذشتهٔ is و are است: برای دیروز، نه امروز. I was، he was، she was، it was. اما we were، you were، they were. گوش کن که فرید دیروز کجا بود.
say_en: f: Farid, where were you yesterday? You were not at school. // m: I was at home.
show_en: Farid, where were you yesterday? You were not at school. I was at home.

say_en: m: I was sick and very tired.
show_en: I was sick and very tired.

say_en: Where was Farid yesterday?
show_en: Where was Farid yesterday?
wrong_say_fa: نه. فرید گفت I was at home: او دیروز در خانه بود، چون مریض بود.

say_en: f: Yesterday it was rainy and cold. // m: Yes. But today it is sunny.
show_en: Yesterday it was rainy and cold. Yes. But today it is sunny.

say_en: What was the weather like yesterday?
show_en: What was the weather like yesterday?
wrong_say_fa: نه. امروز آفتابی است. دیروز بارانی بود: Yesterday it was rainy.

say_en: f: Are you well today? // m: Yes, I am. Yesterday I was sick. Today I am well.
show_en: Yesterday I was sick. Today I am well.

intro_fa: برای کارهای دیروز به آخر فعل ed می‌آید: walk، walked. play، played. cook، cooked. گوش کن که نرگس و برادرش دیروز چه کردند.
say_en: f: Yesterday I walked to the river with my mother. // m: I stayed at home.
show_en: Yesterday I walked to the river with my mother. I stayed at home.

say_en: f: We washed the clothes. Then we carried them home.
show_en: We washed the clothes. Then we carried them home.

say_en: Who washed the clothes with Nargis?
show_en: Who washed the clothes with Nargis?
wrong_say_fa: نه. نرگس با مادرش به دریا رفت و آنها کالا را شستند.

say_en: m: I helped my father. We cooked rice and beans.
show_en: I helped my father. We cooked rice and beans.

say_en: Who cooked with the boy?
show_en: Who cooked with the boy?
wrong_say_fa: نه. برادر گفت I helped my father. We cooked: او با پدرش پخت.

say_en: f: In the afternoon I played with my friends. // m: And it rained in the evening!
show_en: In the afternoon I played with my friends. And it rained in the evening!

intro_fa: بعضی فعل‌ها در گذشته ed نمی‌گیرند و شکل دیگر دارند: go، went. eat، ate. drink، drank. see، saw. give، gave. اینها را باید یاد بگیری.
say_en: m: Yesterday I went to the bazaar with my father. // f: I went to my grandmother.
show_en: Yesterday I went to the bazaar with my father. I went to my grandmother.

say_en: m: We ate kebab and drank tea.
show_en: We ate kebab and drank tea.

say_en: Where was the boy yesterday?
show_en: Where was the boy yesterday?
wrong_say_fa: نه. پسر گفت I went to the bazaar: او دیروز به بازار رفت.

say_en: f: Grandmother gave me walnuts. I saw her new lamb.
show_en: Grandmother gave me walnuts. I saw her new lamb.

say_en: Who gave the walnuts?
show_en: Who gave the walnuts?
wrong_say_fa: نه. دختر گفت Grandmother gave me walnuts: مادرکلان به او چهارمغز داد.

say_en: f: I came home late and slept well. // m: Me too!
show_en: I came home late and slept well. Me too!

intro_fa: برای سوال از گذشته Did را اول می‌آوریم و فعل ساده می‌ماند: Did you go? جواب کوتاه: Yes, I did یا No, I didn't. برای «نه» می‌گوییم didn't: I didn't go.
say_en: f: Did you go to the clinic yesterday? // m: Yes, I did.
show_en: Did you go to the clinic yesterday? Yes, I did.

say_en: f: Did you see the doctor? // m: No, I didn't. I saw the nurse.
show_en: Did you see the doctor? No, I didn't. I saw the nurse.

say_en: Did he see the doctor?
show_en: Did he see the doctor?
wrong_say_fa: نه. او گفت No, I didn't. I saw the nurse: داکتر را ندید، نرس را دید.

say_en: f: What did he do? // m: He washed my knee and gave me a bandage.
show_en: What did he do? He washed my knee and gave me a bandage.

say_en: What did the nurse give him?
show_en: What did the nurse give him?
wrong_say_fa: نه. او گفت He gave me a bandage: نرس به او یک بنداژ داد.

say_en: f: What happened? // m: I fell on the road. But I didn't cry!
show_en: What happened? I fell on the road. But I didn't cry!

intro_fa: برای گفتن ترتیب کارها: First یعنی اول، Then یعنی بعد، After that یعنی بعد از آن. before یعنی پیش از، after یعنی بعد از. گوش کن که زرمینه امروز صبح چه کرد.
say_en: m: What did you do this morning? // f: First I got up and washed my face.
show_en: What did you do this morning? First I got up and washed my face.

say_en: f: Then I ate breakfast with my family.
show_en: Then I ate breakfast with my family.

say_en: What did she do first?
show_en: What did she do first?
wrong_say_fa: نه. او گفت First I got up and washed my face: اول روی خود را شست.

say_en: m: Did you wash your hands before breakfast? // f: Yes, I did. I wash my hands before I eat.
show_en: I wash my hands before I eat.

say_en: f: After that I walked to school.
show_en: After that I walked to school.

say_en: Where did she go after breakfast?
show_en: Where did she go after breakfast?
wrong_say_fa: نه. او گفت After that I walked to school: بعد از آن پیاده به مکتب رفت.

intro_fa: همسایهٔ پیر مریض بود. گوش کن که کی به او کمک کرد و چه برایش برد. brought گذشتهٔ bring است: آورد. visited یعنی به دیدنش رفت.
say_en: f: Our neighbour is old. Last week she was sick. // m: Did you visit her?
show_en: Our neighbour is old. Last week she was sick. Did you visit her?

say_en: f: Yes, I did. I brought soup and bread.
show_en: Yes, I did. I brought soup and bread.

say_en: What did the girl bring?
show_en: What did the girl bring?
wrong_say_fa: نه. دختر گفت I brought soup and bread: او شوربا و نان آورد.

say_en: m: I helped, too. I carried water for her.
show_en: I helped, too. I carried water for her.

say_en: What did the boy carry?
show_en: What did the boy carry?
wrong_say_fa: نه. پسر گفت I carried water for her: او برای همسایه آب برد.

say_en: f: Now she is better. She said: Thank you, you are kind.
show_en: Now she is better. She said: Thank you, you are kind.
